What moves me above both estimates is the recent tape: the index printed 30.89, 30.53, 38.26 and 34.02 within the last eight sessions, closing above 30 in four of them, so the local distribution has clearly fatter upside tails than the analogue's calm median path assumes. I stop at 0.28 rather than higher because the last three sessions have already decayed from 38 to 26.7, and 12 sessions is long enough for a spike to mean-revert below 30.
